tool_input.description: Probe registration API without submitting data
tool_input.command: try { $registrationProbe = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://172.27.13.11:8080/company/base/createTempAccount' -Method Post -ContentType 'application/json' -Body '{}' -UseBasicParsing -SkipHttpErrorCheck -TimeoutSec 15; $registrationResult = $registrationProbe.Content | ConvertFrom-Json; 'HTTP {0}; response code={1}' -f $registrationProbe.StatusCode, $registrationResult.code } catch { 'Registration endpoint probe failed; error type={0}' -f $_.Exception.GetType().Name }
